anvil.windup:
Create a MATCHING WINDUP POSE ATLAS for the exact character in the attached active-pose atlas. The reference is the authoritative character model and style; faithfully preserve face, proportions, equipment, costume construction and exact local colors. Do not redesign the character. Shared series rules: bold clean dark outer contour, thinner interior lines, two-tone cel shadows, top-left neutral key light, muted costume base palette with one controlled saturated identity accent, solid opaque character interior on fully transparent empty background. Avoid painterly rendering, glossy 3D, gradients and soft haze. Smears are NOT needed for windups; no speed lines, impacts, flashes or released attacks. Poses must show stored energy before action, compact silhouettes and bent joints, weapons held back. All poses face screen RIGHT, side/three-quarter fighting game view. Full body and complete weapons must fit inside each cell.
OUTPUT: one 1536x1024 TRANSPARENT RGBA PNG atlas, exact THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows; each cell 512x512. No labels, grid, floor, shadow, environment, decoration or text. Body standing height about 350 pixels, same scale across all cells, grounded feet baseline about y=466 within each cell. Body root x=210 in each cell. Keep at least 20px transparent border. row 1 col1: neutral ready idle matching reference (scale/identity anchor).
row 1 col2: P WINDUP, BEFORE its attack.
row 1 col3: K WINDUP, BEFORE its attack.
row 2 col1: S WINDUP, BEFORE its attack.
row 2 col2: Hs WINDUP, BEFORE its attack.
row 2 col3: D WINDUP, BEFORE its attack.
Anvil: short broad heavy silhouette, bald head, huge white beard, brown leather and gray steel, rectangular blacksmith shield on left arm and beaked hammer in right. P: retract shield near ribs preparing a short shield jab. K: shift weight back, lift front knee close to body before boot thrust. S: pull beaked hammer back at waist before forward sweep. Hs: draw hammer behind and just above shoulder, elbow bent, BEFORE overhead swing. D: plant feet and tuck behind shield before a forward shield bash.
